title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: OCR scanning of images on Mac devices
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, OCR pricing, file limits and billing permissions match the sources. It correctly distinguishes documented tenant-level enablement from the unanswered rollout question for tenants already using device OCR; some navigation details and checklist coverage need minor corrections.

claims.quote: We are adding OCR support on Mac endpoints to detect sensitive content in images and apply policies to protect these images.

claims.claim: The roadmap says images are not supported for content scanning on Mac endpoint devices today.
claims.quote: images are not supported for content scanning today on Mac endpoint devices.

claims.quote: Before rollout: confirm billing; use the OCR cost estimator; check proxy and firewall rules. At rollout: review existing DLP rules. After rollout: watch the OCR meter in Cost Management. The table covers OCR scope, bandwidth, path exclusions and device monitoring.
claims.fix: The checklist's billing, cost-estimator, network-rule, existing-DLP-rule and Cost Management checks have no corresponding rows. Remove those checklist bullets to bring the checklist into agreement with the existing table; retain their documented facts in the prose.
